scripts.dev: node scripts/check-port.cjs && pnpm build && concurrently -k -s first "pnpm --dir ../web exec next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000" "wait-on --timeout 60000 --interval 500 http://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron ."
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && node scripts/write-build-config.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:win:publish: pnpm build && node scripts/write-build-config.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish always
